scripts.shot:check: npm run build && node scripts/shot.mjs && node scripts/shot-ref.mjs check
scripts.shot:accept: npm run build && node scripts/shot.mjs && node scripts/shot-ref.mjs accept
scripts.film:check: npm run film -- --run runs/s42 --overlay material --cam iso --every 100 --fps 12 --out film/s42-material.mp4 --max-seconds 300 && node scripts/film-check.mjs film/s42-material.mp4
scripts.film:tiled:check: npm run film -- --run runs/s42 --tiles material:iso,fire:top,crowding:top,traits:top --layout 2x2 --every 100 --fps 12 --out film/s42-tiled.mp4 --max-seconds 700 && node scripts/film-check.mjs film/s42-tiled.mp4
